title.zh: 修正日语初级词库释义质量

purpose.en: Repair Japanese Beginner homographs and noisy automated glosses discovered by the production full-user test, while preserving the complete 1,000-word trial.
purpose.zh: 修复生产环境完整用户测试发现的日语 Beginner 同形异义词和自动释义噪声，同时保留完整 1,000 词试学。

en: Correct 972 Japanese Beginner entries using applicable common senses from EDRDG JMdict.
Match homographs against the intended catalog gloss and apply explicit core-grammar teaching meanings.
Replace fifteen media abbreviations or bare fragments with common dictionary-backed learner words.
Publish vocabulary source and CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution and prevent stale trial API responses.
zh: 依据 EDRDG JMdict 的适用常用义项修正 972 条日语 Beginner 词汇。
依据原课程目标匹配同形异义词，并为核心语法提供明确教学释义。
把 15 个媒体缩写或残缺词干替换为有词典依据的常用学习词。
公开词汇来源与 CC BY-SA 4.0 鸣谢，并禁止试学接口返回过期缓存。

en: Japanese Beginner vocabulary catalog and read API
zh: 中文界面的日语 Beginner 匿名试学
日语 Beginner 词汇目录和只读接口
关于页面的词汇数据鸣谢

en: Add a forward-only 972-row D1 correction migration without editing applied catalog history.
Add a reproducible offline JMdict correction builder with sense matching and fail-closed translation gates.
Reject long, empty, repeated, or placeholder Chinese glosses in automated corpus tests.
Retain exactly 1,000 published Japanese Beginner entries and complete twelve-language reading aids.
zh: 新增 972 行前向 D1 修正迁移，不修改已应用的历史词库迁移。
新增可复现的离线 JMdict 修正生成器，包含义项匹配和失败即停止的翻译门禁。
自动语料测试拒绝过长、空白、重复或占位符中文释义。
保持日语 Beginner 恰好 1,000 个已发布词条和完整十二语言助读。

en: Full site suite including the 48,000-row multilingual vocabulary, pronunciation, provenance, and Japanese sense gates
Verified production build, D1 migration, artifact validation, sensitive-data scan, and source-drift checks
Chrome and Safari production tests of the Chinese-interface Japanese Beginner card, correct meaning, report counts, and repeat-after-AI flow
zh: 完整站点测试，包括 48,000 条多语言词汇、音标、来源和日语义项门禁
已验证生产构建、D1 迁移、产物、敏感信息扫描和源码漂移检查
使用 Chrome 与 Safari 在生产环境验证中文界面日语初级卡片、正确释义、报告数量和跟 AI 跟读流程

en: Live microphone scoring still requires the user's browser permission and spoken input; this data-quality release does not retain audio or transcripts.
zh: 实时发音评分仍需用户允许浏览器麦克风并实际开口；本次数据质量发布不保留音频或文字。

en: Keep SmartLingo vocabulary data, learner progress, identity, and deployment resources site-local; anonymous trial access is read-only.
zh: SmartLingo 词汇数据、学习进度、身份系统和部署资源均保持本站独立；匿名试学只读访问。
